flashcard_questions.q: The resources needed to produce goods and services: land, labour, capital, and enterprise.
The difference between the selling price of a product and the cost of the inputs used to make it.
A feature that makes a product or service stand out from those offered by competitors.

flashcard_questions.a: A person who organises resources, makes business decisions, and takes risks in order to start and run a business.
The willingness to take a chance on a new business idea, accepting that it may fail and result in financial loss.
